title: According to the text, what is stated
subtitle: Central Ideas and Details · 11 official questions

sections.heading: Where this sits for you
body: **11 of the official questions in Central Ideas and Details are this one** — 8 Easy, 3 Medium, 0 Hard.
It is bottom-heavy, which makes it cheap points. Secure it early.

sections.heading: How to spot it
body: You are looking at this pattern when:

- The stem begins 'According to the text...' and asks something narrow: what someone did, why a group is worried, what was surprising, how old or how large something is, how one person differed from others.
- The choices are short and specific, sometimes just numbers.

sections.heading: The method
body: - 1) Find the one sentence that answers the question word (why, what, how old, how differed).
- 2) Match the choice that paraphrases that sentence.
- 3) Eliminate any choice that uses a detail from somewhere else in the passage.

sections.heading: What it is built to catch
body: The distractors are drawn from other parts of the passage: a different number the passage also mentions (a range boundary instead of the actual age), a different character's activity, or the proposed solution offered as the cause.
Every word in them appears in the text, but they answer a different question.

sections.heading: You are losing these
body: Before you choose, say out loud what the question is asking for — not what you solved for.
